name: 複数の役割を示すメンバー属性
prompt: Create attempt a002, the second and final fidelity pass. The first reference is the exact 390x184 Japanese native preview and controls every label, color, position, size and grid gap. The second is the close current candidate. Preserve its exact nine labels, three rows, three columns, green dots and white pills. Correct only the measured bounds: the native card is x=16,y=8,width≈358,height≈160; in the candidate, its top edge is about 7px too low and its height is about 7px too short while the bottom edge already aligns. Move the card top up about 7px and preserve its bottom edge. Raise the title and entire pill grid about 4px. Each pill should be about 104px wide, about 3–4px narrower than the candidate, with column starts near x=30,140,250 and consistent row heights/gaps. Keep title 「役割」 at x≈29, exact Japanese labels in the same order: 「画面づくり」「企画担当」「学生」; 「地域の仲間」「海外の仲間」「呼称：彼女」; 「交流会」「確認済み」「個別連絡可」. Preserve the native pale mint card, white pills, small green dots and dark muted text. These pills are labels, not hyperlinks. Do not turn any text blue. Do not add source English copy, varied dot colors, extra content, shadows, or borders.
reviewNotes: Version 2 aligns card top and title close to native, but card bottom is about 4px high and all three pill rows remain about 4px high at native scale. Pill widths/column positions still drift about 1–5px. Labels, dots and ordering are exact. Two-attempt limit reached; preserve both. No hyperlinks.
